lawRefs: CMS fact sheet "2026 Medicare Parts A & B Premiums and Deductibles" (2025-11-14)
2026 Medicare Trustees Report, Table V.E2 (Part D base beneficiary premium $38.99, deductible $615, out-of-pocket threshold $2,100)
header.notes: Parts A/B amounts and all IRMAA tiers transcribed from the CMS fact sheet (HTML). Part D parameters from the 2026 Medicare Trustees Report Table V.E2 and the CY2026 Rate Announcement. The `defaults` block is NOT law: it holds editable planning estimates (benchmarks) that the user can override. IRMAA `magiOver` semantics: the top tier legally starts AT the threshold ("greater than or equal to" $500,000 / $750,000; MFS second tier ends "less than" its upper bound), all other tiers start ABOVE it. Premiums are dollars and cents. sha256 is of the raw source document as downloaded.

flags.defaults.medigapGMonthlyAt65: estimate; consumer rate surveys for a 65-year-old range about $150-$190/month (2026); varies widely by state and insurer
flags.defaults.medigapNMonthlyAt65: estimate; consumer rate surveys range about $120-$140/month (2026)
flags.defaults.medigapAgeRating: assumption (attained-age rating of roughly 2-3% a year above trend); not from a primary source
flags.defaults.advantageMonthly: CMS projected enrollment-weighted average MA premium for 2026 (press release 2026-09-28)
flags.defaults.advantageTypicalOop: assumption; not from a primary source
flags.defaults.advantageMaxOop: KFF enrollment-weighted average in-network out-of-pocket limit for 2026 ($5,421); the federal ceiling is $9,250
flags.defaults.partDPlanMonthly: CMS projected average stand-alone PDP total premium for 2026 (press release 2026-09-28)
flags.defaults.dentalVisionHearingAnnual: assumption; not from a primary source
flags.defaults.medigapGTypicalOop: Plan G leaves only the Part B deductible
flags.defaults.medigapNTypicalOop: assumption: Part B deductible plus about six $20 office-visit copays
flags.defaults.partDTypicalOop: assumption; `high` is the statutory out-of-pocket cap
